scenario.name: Pull-over minimal risk manoeuvre along a busy kerb
scenario.description: Autoware pulls over after a stop request or a minor fault, where the kerb has bike lanes, driveways, bus stops or crosswalks

triggers.condition: Bike lanes, driveways, bus stops or crosswalks along the kerb where a pull-over is tried

scenario.meant: pulls over only into a mapped stop
scenario.pass: The vehicle pulls over only into a mapped safe stopping place and stops in lane otherwise; repeated stop requests go to a remote operator

parameters.label: ODD-20 Ego speed: 43.4 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)

legend.plan: Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
legend.envelope: Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
legend.meant: Meant to do: pulls over only into a mapped stop
legend.meant_mark: Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
legend.hazard: Where the hazard lies: Pull-over minimal risk manoeuvre along a busy kerb
legend.key: Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about

ego.motion_label: Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033); choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
